about: Golden expectations for scripts.audit_competition_phases: the stage and kind of each named table of the season's newest snapshot, and the table each side of a named match is shown with (home, away). Structures read from the provider's /standings and /fixtures round labels and checked against the competitions' formats; the Colombia case is the owner's report of 4 Oct 2026 (Match Center Llaneros v America de Cali showing a Clausura row and an Apertura row; the provider's widget shows the Apertura and Clausura tables apart).

seasons.name: Colombia Primera A
seasons.format: Apertura and Clausura, each a 19-round league then knock-out rounds (quarter-finals, semi-finals, final)

fixtures.note: Llaneros v America de Cali, Clausura - 13 (the P0 report)
America de Cali v Llaneros, Apertura - 13

seasons.name: Argentina Liga Profesional
seasons.format: Apertura and Clausura, each played in two zones of 15 (Group A, Group B) with interzonal matches, then knock-out rounds

fixtures.note: Lanus v Velez Sarsfield, Clausura - 12: one zone
Boca Juniors v Huracan, Apertura - Round of 16: each team's Apertura zone

seasons.name: Peru Liga 1
seasons.format: Apertura and Clausura leagues; the annual table adds both

fixtures.note: Sporting Cristal v Comerciantes Unidos, Clausura - 12

seasons.name: Ecuador Liga Pro
seasons.format: a 30-round regular season, then championship, placement and relegation groups whose tables carry the regular season's games

fixtures.note: Barcelona SC v Independiente del Valle, Championship Group - 1

seasons.name: MLS
seasons.format: one regular season ranked in two conferences, then the MLS Cup play-offs

fixtures.note: New York City FC v Los Angeles FC: each team's conference

seasons.name: FIFA World Cup
seasons.format: 12 groups of 4 and the ranking of the third-placed teams, then knock-out rounds from the round of 32

fixtures.note: South Africa v Canada, Round of 32: each team's group

seasons.name: UEFA Euro 2024
seasons.format: six groups, each a stage of its own in the round labels ("Group A - 1"), and the ranking of third-placed teams

fixtures.note: Spain v Georgia, Round of 16: each team's group

seasons.name: UEFA Champions League
seasons.format: knock-out qualifying rounds, then one 36-team league phase

seasons.name: Eerste Divisie
seasons.format: one regular season and four period tables (period titles)

fixtures.note: NAC Breda v Heracles, Regular Season - 12: the season's table, never a period's

seasons.name: CONMEBOL Libertadores
seasons.format: knock-out qualifying rounds, eight groups of four, then knock-out rounds; Medellin v Flamengo awarded (AWD)

fixtures.note: Independiente Medellin v Flamengo (AWD), Group Stage - 4
